0022600174.text: Atlanta (4-4, 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, 7th in the East, currently on a win) visits Washington (4-3, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East, on a two-game win streak) in this ninth game of the Hawks' season. The Hawks are without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot, fracture), while Jalen Johnson (ankle) and Jock Landale (hip) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The Wizards are missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), with Alex Sarr (knee soreness) and Anthony Gill (back spasms) also day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after the Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 126-96 Atlanta win on February 26, 2026.
